note: Queue job #8104 (2026-11-18): six parallel translators plus a whole-book reconciliation pass. Scripture from the 口語訳聖書 (1954/55, public domain) as served by getBible v2 (japkougo), the same text as Take Root japkougo, which returned 502 throughout the job. Every mined row was checked as a verbatim substring of that verse. Romans 10 is absent from getBible japkougo (404), so Romans 10:9 is self_rendered. AI-drafted, awaiting native review.

Re-quoted 2026-11-25: Scripture is now the Open Word Bible (OWB), Japanese, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-ja-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-ja), per the founder decision that Japanese quotes OWB for every work (2026-11-19). A `mined` row is a quotation or verbatim recitation whose every piece (pieces joined by '……' allowed) is a verbatim span of the cited OWB verse(s); `allusion` and `self_rendered` rows carry their reason in `why`. Romans 10 is in OWB, so the old Romans 10:9 gap no longer applies (both mentions are the author's paraphrase). AI-drafted, awaiting native review.
